title: REQ · Mock provider runs as a runner.Agent and labels its output as mock
summary: Mock agent writes a MOCK marker file and costs 0
description: Context: no Agent implementation exists. Desired behavior: Mock.Run(ctx, workDir) writes MOCK-EXECUTION.md saying no real development happened and returns cost 0. Expected result: mock runs are distinguishable from real ones. Why: the master prompt requires mock execution to be clearly distinguished.
acceptance_criteria: Given a temp work dir, When Mock.Run is called, Then MOCK-EXECUTION.md exists and contains the text MOCK
Given Mock.Run succeeds, When the cost is read, Then it equals 0 and the error is nil
Given a cancelled context, When Mock.Run is called, Then it returns the context error and writes no file
